source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My Agent keeps calling a payment API with wrong parameters and sometimes double-charges users. How do I prevent this?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate harness-engineering and implement Constrain (validate parameters before execution), Verify (confirm charge went through), Correct (rollback on duplicate detection)

test_cases.prompt: I need to deploy a customer service Agent that can cancel orders and issue refunds. What safety measures do I need?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate harness-engineering for risk-rated tools, human-in-the-loop for high-risk operations, circuit breaker for repeated failures

test_cases.prompt: My Agent gets stuck in infinite loops when a tool fails. How do I add error recovery?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate harness-engineering, implement Correct layer (circuit breaker, max retries, fallback to human)

test_cases.prompt: Help me write a better system prompt for my chatbot so it gives more helpful answers
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate harness-engineering; this is prompt engineering, not Harness engineering

test_cases.prompt: How do I compress my Agent conversation history to save tokens?
I have a simple Agent that just calls one weather API and returns the result. Do I need a Harness?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Minimal Harness needed: basic error handling for API failures. Full 5-layer Harness is overkill. Use judgment based on consequences of failure.
